pattern.rule: In a design item whose stem names the variable, factor or object to be tested or isolated ('which study / comparison / experiment would best test ...', 'which trials should be compared to determine whether ...'), pick the only option that varies, manipulates or examines that stem-named variable/object alone; every other option varies or measures something else.
